_README: R12/R13 — libretto speaker labels that do not match any stave name.
EVERY MAPPING IN HERE IS A GUESS BY THE TOOL AND IS MEANT TO BE CORRECTED.
["Soprano", "Alto"]  -> this body sings those voice parts
"*create*"           -> a named character the archive never gave a stave;
"*principal:Soprano*" -> R5: a chorus member who steps out for a line and
returns. Gets a FULL-LENGTH stave copied from that
chorus voice; their solo text is placed where the
libretto attributes it, chorus text elsewhere.
The voice named after the colon is a GUESS.
R13 builds one from the lyric-crib notes
run time to whoever is sounding and not already
"*ignore*"           -> not a speaker; a parse artefact
Counts in comments are how many libretto blocks used the label.
